title: News report of the Oklahoma City bombing

tellings.quote: >> A massive car bomb exploded outside of a large federal building in downtown Oklahoma City, shattering that building, killing children, killing federal employees, military men, and civilians.

plain: An archival news report is played on the show describing the 1995 Oklahoma City bombing: "A massive car bomb exploded outside of a large federal building in downtown Oklahoma City, shattering that building, killing children, killing federal employees, military men, and civilians." The unnamed reporter's clip appears in an episode about a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies.
